title: Atomic Theory and Structure - Chemistry - Isotopes & Atomic Mass
subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Which of the following pairs represents isotopes of the same element?
questions.explain: Isotopes are atoms of the same element (same atomic number/symbol) with different mass numbers. $^{12}\text{C}$ and $^{13}\text{C}$ are both Carbon but have different masses.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Copper has two naturally occurring isotopes: $^{63}\text{Cu}$ (mass 62.93 amu, abundance 69.17%) and $^{65}\text{Cu}$ (mass 64.93 amu, abundance 30.83%). Which expression correctly calculates the average atomic mass?
questions.explain: Average atomic mass is the weighted average: $\sum (	\text{Isotope Mass} \times 	\text{Fractional Abundance})$. The percentages must be converted to decimals (e.g., 69.17% = 0.6917).
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Element X has two isotopes: X-10 (mass 10.0 amu, 20.0% abundance) and X-11 (mass 11.0 amu, 80.0% abundance). What is the average atomic mass of Element X?
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Why is the atomic mass of Chlorine listed as 35.45 amu on the periodic table rather than a whole number?
options: Protons and neutrons have slightly different masses.
The mass of electrons is included.
It is a weighted average of the masses of naturally occurring isotopes.
questions.explain: The atomic mass on the periodic table is a weighted average of all naturally occurring isotopes. Since Chlorine exists as Cl-35 and Cl-37, the average falls between them.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Boron has an average atomic mass of 10.81 amu. It consists of two isotopes: Boron-10 and Boron-11. Which isotope is more abundant?
options: Cannot be determined without density data.
questions.explain: The average mass (10.81) is much closer to 11 than to 10, implying that Boron-11 is the more abundant isotope (approx 80%).
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: An element has three isotopes with masses 24, 25, and 26. If the average atomic mass is 24.31, which isotope is likely the most abundant?
questions.explain: Since the average (24.31) is closest to 24, the isotope with mass 24 must have the highest natural abundance.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Two atoms are isotopes if they have:
options: Different atomic numbers but same mass number
Same atomic number but different number of electrons
Same atomic number but different mass numbers
Same mass number but different chemical properties
questions.explain: Isotopes are defined as atoms with the same number of protons (atomic number) but different numbers of neutrons (and thus different mass numbers).
